description: This file defines a class 'TableOfContentsRenderer' which implements the NodeRendererInterface to render a table of contents in HTML format for a Markdown content type within the Daux documentation generator. It constructs the renderer with configuration and delegates rendering to a parent list renderer, then integrates with a templating engine to produce the final HTML output.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for generating HTML output of a table of contents from a Markdown node within the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with configuration and sets up the parent list renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the table of contents node to HTML by asserting node type, delegating actual rendering to the parent renderer, and then wrapping the output with a template engine.
